other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
Reservation percentages differ for rural (SC/ST 50%, Minorities 7%, others 43%) and urban areas (SC 17%, ST 6%, Minorities 12%, others 65%).
benefits_summary: Provides a fully subsidized 560 sq ft double‑bedroom house with free land (125 sq yd in rural areas, 36 sq yd in urban areas) and no beneficiary contribution.
